posts.text: This report is dated January,2026. Since then lot of turbulence in domestic and international field. Don’t know the impact of Gulf war and high crude prices on the company. Also there is substantial up and down in the numbers on QOQ. That is performance is not linear. Company does not do concalls, at least I did not come across any. Any members tracking the company may give updates.
